CRITICAL
- Exactly 8 sprites, one per cell of the attached layout grid; the unused ninth position stays empty.
- The same character in all 8 cells: same silhouette, proportions, size, colours, outfit and equipment.
- Strict side view, orthographic, facing right, full body, feet on the same baseline in every cell.

ART DIRECTION
World: a quiet medieval fantasy world of long roads, forests and cold nights.
Era: early middle ages, mail and spears, before gunpowder.
Rendering: 2D pixel art, crisp blocky pixels, solid black outline one pixel wide, flat shading.
Camera: side view, orthographic, the character facing right.

CHARACTER — a hooded traveller
- deep teal hooded cloak covering the head and falling down the back
- ochre long coat closed by a brown leather belt
- brown leather backpack with a rolled bedroll strapped on top
- brown boots
- a lit lantern hanging from the near hand

REFERENCES (priority if they conflict: 1 > 2 > 3)
1. Image 3 — the character, already drawn in the game's camera: the identity to keep.
2. Images 1 and 2 — official artworks: the colours, outfit and drawing style to follow. Do not copy their pose, camera angle, scenery or layout.
3. Image 4 — empty layout grid: the 8 cells to fill, at their exact positions and sizes.

SPRITE SHEET
8 sprites on the attached 3×3 layout: 8 cells used in reading order, the last position empty. One sprite per cell, centred in its cell, the same height in every cell, feet on the cell's baseline.

ANIMATION — walk cycle, one instant per cell
1. contact, left foot forward
2. down, weight on left foot
3. passing, right leg swinging through
4. up, left leg straight, body highest
5. contact, right foot forward
6. down, weight on right foot
7. passing, left leg swinging through
8. up, right leg straight, body highest

CONSISTENCY
The lantern stays in the same hand and barely swings. The hood keeps the same silhouette; only the lower cloak may sway with the stride. Nothing else changes between cells except the pose of the legs and arms.

EXCLUSIONS
No cell borders, no grid lines, no separating lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no frames, no ground shadow, no scenery, no extra characters.
